2024-04-06
First notice of loss received from the insured's agent reporting a sideswipe while changing lanes on a multi-lane road.
The claimant, a passenger in the insured's vehicle, reports a back strain and has retained counsel.
2024-04-29
Reviewed the policy file and confirmed the driver is named on the policy and coverage was in force at the time of loss.
No coverage issues identified at this stage.
2024-04-30
Obtained the police report, which places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene and describes the lane-change
impact consistent with the account given by the insured.
2024-06-03
Took recorded statements from the other driver and two independent witnesses. Each describes the sideswipe as it
was reported to us, with no material differences in sequence.
2024-06-24
Reviewed scene photographs and the damage estimate on both vehicles. The damage pattern lines up with the
described impact along the right rear quarter panel.
2024-07-03
Checked vehicle history and prior claim records. No earlier damage to this vehicle is on file, and nothing suggests the
damage predates the policy inception.
2024-07-16
Spoke with the claimant's attorney, who provided the initial medical records. The claimant's account of the collision
matches what was given in earlier conversations with our office.
2024-07-31
Medical records show a lumbar strain diagnosed at urgent care. The injury is a typical outcome for a collision of this
type, and the records reference no prior treatment to the same body area.
2024-08-22
Received the treatment log from the provider. Care followed a usual course of physical therapy and tapeerd as the
claimant reported steady improvement in mobility and pain levels.
2024-09-05
Requested prior medical history through counsel. No earlier injury or complaint involving the same region of the back
appears in the records received to date.
2024-10-30
Reviewed the file with the handling supervisor. Liability and damage appear settled, the injury is consistent with the
mechanism, and the claim is moving to evaluation of the treatment cuorse and resolution.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
